+<!doctype html>
+<html lang="en">
+<head>
+<meta charset="utf-8">
+<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
+<title>Fetch</title>
+</head>
+<body>
+<button id="go" type="button">Load</button>
+<script>
+document.getElementById('go').addEventListener('click', async () => {
+  // Analytics is non-critical: low priority so it doesn't compete with /api/data.
+  fetch('/api/analytics', {
+    method: 'POST',
+    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+    body: JSON.stringify({ click: 1 }),
+    priority: 'low',
+    keepalive: true
+  }).catch(() => {});
+
+  // Mission-critical: high priority.
+  const res = await fetch('/api/data', { priority: 'high' });
+  console.log(await res.json());
+});
+</script>
+</body>
+</html>
